crossRefs.note: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

translations.web: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
translations.bsb: A discerning heart seeks knowledge, but the mouth of a fool feeds on folly.
translations.kjv: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
translations.asv: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge; But the mouth of fools feedeth on folly.
